dct_description_sm:
The parcel outlines represent tax parcel boundaries, not ownership. For Land Ownership please confirm with the Land Registry Office.

The parcel lines shown on the map do not represent a Plan of Survey nor do they represent the City’s opinion as to the true location of the parcel line. For an accurate opinion of the boundary location, the user should consult with an Ontario Land Surveyor.

This dataset will be updated on a monthly basis. 

DISCLAIMER

Please be advised GIS_AREA values are based on the NAD83 Zone17N Datum and Shape_Area and Shape_Length Values are based on the WGS84 Web Mercator Datum
